name: Peony Plague
source:
A kinetic visual novel following Peregrine Abbott as he discusses the funeral planning with the soon-to-be deceased, Rowan Francine. The two knew each other years ago but neither could imagine this to be their reunion. 

Peregrine's goal is to uncover how Rowan wishes to be taken care of after he dies, but it seems that Rowan isn't all that interested in discussing his death, let alone what would follow afterwards.

[From [url=https://ocreatus.itch.io/peony-plague]itch.io[/url]]
